title: Origins of stop time and George Boyd's piece Number One
summary: Miller says stop time began with tap dancers and describes George Boyd's piece with band stops.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets
